repo.local: Local view, not checked with GitHub · read at {{time}}
repo.localHelp: Ahead and behind compare this computer's copy with what it last fetched. GitHub may have moved since.
repo.none.title: Not a repository
repo.none.body: This folder is not inside a Git repository on this computer.
repo.failed.title: Couldn't read the repository
repo.failed.body: The agent on this computer did not answer with the repository's state. Try again.
account.title: GitHub account needed
account.not_linked: No GitHub account is linked in this realm on this computer. Add one in Settings → Connections.
account.account_missing: The GitHub account in use was removed. Pick another one in Settings → Connections.
account.token_invalid: GitHub no longer accepts the account in use. Add it again in Settings → Connections.
account.token_forbidden: GitHub refused the account in use: its token may lack a permission, this repository, or an organization's approval. Or pick another in Connections.
account.store_corrupt: The agent can't read its GitHub account list on this computer. Add the account again in Settings → Connections.
account.store_unavailable: The agent's GitHub account list can't be read right now. Try again in a moment.
account.global.not_linked: No GitHub account is linked in Global on this computer.
account.global.account_missing: The GitHub account in use was removed.
account.global.token_invalid: GitHub no longer accepts the account in use.
account.global.token_forbidden: GitHub refused this request for the account in use: its token may lack a permission, access to this repository, or an organization's approval.
account.global.store_corrupt: The agent can't read its GitHub account list on this computer.
account.where.pinned: A shared-access session does not reach Global. Global accounts are changed from a session signed in to the account.
account.where.global: Connections acts for the computer chosen in the top bar: choose {{computer}} there first. It opens on All realms and Global.
account.where: This folder is on {{computer}} in {{realm}}. Connections links the account for the computer chosen in the top bar: choose {{computer}} there first.
changes.untracked_one: {{count}} new file is not tracked yet: it shows in no diff.
changes.untracked_other: {{count}} new files are not tracked yet: they show in no diff.
changes.truncated: The diff is longer than the agent sends (1 MiB): the last files may be missing or cut.
changes.pick: Pick a file to see its diff.
history.subject: Message
history.author: Author
history.note: The 100 newest commits on this computer.
branches.name: Branch
branches.new.title: New branch
branches.new.name: Branch name
branches.new.help: It starts at the current commit, and this folder moves onto it. It is local: it does not track a branch on GitHub yet.
branches.new.taken: This folder already has a branch with this name.
branches.new.bad: This name can't be a branch name. Use no spaces, no .. and none of ~ ^ : ? * [ \, and don't start it with a dash, dot or slash or end it with a dot, slash or .lock.
branches.currentReason: This folder is on this branch
branches.delete.title: Delete branch {{branch}}?
branches.delete.body: The delete is forced: commits of the branch merged nowhere else are lost from this folder on {{computer}}. A branch of the same name on GitHub stays.
worktrees.detached: No branch: on a single commit
worktrees.new.title: Add a worktree
worktrees.new.help: A second working folder of this repository, on its own branch.
worktrees.new.pathBad: An absolute path that does not exist yet, without .. and without a slash at the end.
worktrees.new.branchHelp: Empty: use Start from as it is.
worktrees.new.startHelp: A branch, tag or commit; empty: the current commit.
worktrees.new.refBad: This name can't be used. Use no spaces, no .. and none of ~ ^ : ? * [ \, and don't start it with a dash, dot or slash or end it with a dot, slash or .lock.
worktrees.new.pathHelp: Needed: the absolute path of a folder that does not exist yet.
worktrees.mainReason: The main folder of the repository cannot be removed
worktrees.remove.title: Remove worktree {{path}}?
worktrees.remove.body: Deletes its folder on {{computer}}; its branch stays. With uncommitted or untracked changes, or a lock, it is refused and nothing changes.
worktrees.force.title: Remove worktree {{path}} anyway?
worktrees.force.body: Deletes its folder on {{computer}} with its uncommitted and untracked changes: not stashed, not recoverable. Its branch stays.
folder.label: Folder: {{name}}
folder.incomplete.title: This folder link isn't complete
folder.incomplete.body: A folder link names the folder, its computer and one realm. Open the folder again from a chat or the chat list.
folder.missing.title: This computer isn't in your account
folder.missing.body: No computer of yours is named {{handle}}. It may have been deleted or renamed.
folder.unchecked.title: Couldn't check every computer
folder.unchecked.body: This link could not check whether there are more computers, so {{handle}} couldn't be confirmed. Open the folder from its computer's chats.
folder.twin.title: More than one computer has this name
folder.twin.body: Several of your computers are named {{handle}}, so this link can't tell which one it means. Open the folder from its computer's chats.
folder.memory.title: Memory for this folder
folder.memory.body: What the agents remember about this folder is in Knowledge → Memory, under its project.
folder.automations.title: Automations in this folder
folder.automations.body: Loops and workflows that work in this folder are listed under Automations.
write.messageHelp: Everything changed in this folder is staged and recorded with this message.
write.suggestHelp: Suggest a message sends this folder's diff to {{model}} and is billed like any call to it.
write.suggested: Suggested by {{model}} · {{cost}}. Read it before you commit.
write.suggestFailed: No suggestion came back. Nothing in the folder changed: try again, or write the message yourself.
write.suggestNothing: Nothing to commit: there is no change to describe.
write.blocked: An earlier write of this folder may have gone through: settle it above first.
write.pullHelp: Fetch, then pull into this folder
write.pushHelp: Push this folder's commits to GitHub
write.pushAnywayHelp: Replace the branch on GitHub with this folder's
write.pushForce.title: Push anyway?
write.pushForce.body: Replaces the branch on GitHub with this folder's. Commits only GitHub has are lost. If GitHub moved since the last fetch, nothing changes.
write.pushAgain.title: Stop tracking the earlier write and push?
write.pushAgain.body: The earlier write may have gone through. Pushing now stops tracking it and sends a new push; nothing of the earlier one is sent again.
write.commit.refused: Not committed: refused by the repository
write.commit.conflicts: Not committed: resolve the merge conflicts first
write.commit.unknown: Unknown: it may have been recorded
write.commit.mine: Commit created ({{sha}}: you confirmed it in the history)
write.notRunCode: Not run: the agent stopped it ({{code}})
write.push.unknown: Unknown: it may have reached GitHub
write.push.forceHint: If GitHub has commits this folder does not, Push anyway, in the menu next to Sync, replaces them, after a confirm
write.branch.done.branchCreate: Created; this folder is now on it. It does not track a branch on GitHub yet
write.branch.done.branchSwitch: This folder is now on it
write.branch.done.branchDelete: Deleted on this computer; a branch of the same name on GitHub stays
write.branch.refused: Not changed: refused by the repository
write.worktree.forceRefused: Stopped with an error: part of its folder may already be deleted
write.worktree.forceHint: If its changes or a lock stopped it, Remove anyway, on its row in Worktrees, removes it with them, after a confirm
write.step.unknown: Unknown: no result came back for this step
write.doNotCommitAgain: The commit is on this computer. Do not commit again: push it with Push when you choose to.
write.lost: Sent at {{time}}. No answer came back, so nothing shows whether it went through. It is never sent again on its own.
write.checkLine: Check again reads this folder's history and status: nothing is sent.
write.checkLineBranch: Check again reads this folder's branches and status: nothing is sent.
write.checkLineWorktree: Check again reads this folder's worktrees and status: nothing is sent.
write.stopLine: Stop tracking lets this write go: the next press sends anew.
write.historyNone: The history shows no commit with this message.
write.historyNoMessage: This tab no longer has the message it was sent with, so no commit is offered: compare the newest commits yourself.
write.localLine: Local view, as of the last fetch at {{time}}
write.branchNowNone: This folder is on no branch
write.branchReadFailed: Could not read the branch list again, so nothing is shown as current
write.worktreeReadFailed: Could not read the worktree list again, so nothing is shown
write.busyReason: A write of this folder is being sent
